section: The five Deccan Sultanates - Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmednagar, Bidar, Berar; Golconda and Andhra

accepted.s: Who was the first Qutb Shahi ruler to mint coins?
accepted.x: Ibrahim Qutb Shah was the first ruler of the Qutb Shahi dynasty to mint coins.
accepted.tq: Use the FIRST/LAST distinction and match the specific ruler with the institutional development.

accepted.s: The first European factory established in Andhra was set up by the:
accepted.x: The Dutch established the first European factory in Andhra at Machilipatnam in 1605.
accepted.tq: Test the combined identity-place-year link directly.

accepted.s: Machilipatnam port works are associated with the revival of which historical port facility of the Golconda period?
accepted.x: The revival of Machilipatnam port is linked with the historical Gilakaladindi port, which functioned as a transshipment hub under the Golconda dynasty.
accepted.tq: Connect the present development with its historical institution and location.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Golconda Blue diamond?
o: A 23.24-carat fancy vivid blue, pear-shaped diamond
A 24.32-carat fancy vivid blue, round-cut diamond
accepted.x: The Golconda Blue is described as a 23.24-carat, fancy vivid blue, pear-shaped diamond.
accepted.tq: Split the option into weight, colour grade, and shape; all three details must match.

accepted.s: With reference to the Kohinoor, which of the following statements is correct?
o: Pakistan claimed it in 1976, and it has been in British hands since 1849.
Afghanistan claimed it in 1976, and it has been in British hands since 1849.
Pakistan claimed it in 1984, and it has been in British hands since 1947.
Pakistan claimed it in 1947, and it has been in British hands since 1857.
accepted.x: Pakistan made a claim to the Kohinoor in 1976, while the diamond has been in British hands since 1849.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely related claim-year and possession-year pairs.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Hussain Sagar:
1. It was named after Hussain Shah Wali.
2. It was built under Ibrahim.
3. It was declared the UNWTO ‘Heart of the World’ in 2012.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Hussain Sagar was named after Hussain Shah Wali, built under Ibrahim, and received the UNWTO designation ‘Heart of the World’ in 2012.
accepted.tq: Check each statement independently, especially the name, patron, and recognition-year details.

accepted.s: Bonalu festival in Telangana is particularly associated with the Jagadamba Mahankali temple located inside the:
accepted.x: The Jagadamba Mahankali temple associated with Bonalu is situated inside Golconda Fort.
accepted.tq: Use the location-based identification method for a festival and its associated monument.

accepted.s: The Bonalu festival is regarded as having roots extending to which periods?
accepted.x: Bonalu is associated with traditions extending back to the Kakatiya and Qutb Shahi periods.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the historically associated dynastic pair from neighbouring Deccan dynasties.

accepted.s: The Qutb Shahis are credited with uniting the Telugu lands for the:
o: First time, after the Mauryas and Satavahanas
Second time, after the Cholas and Kakatiyas
Third time, after the Satavahanas and Kakatiyas
Fourth time, after the Vijayanagara and Bahmani kingdoms
accepted.x: The Qutb Shahis united the Telugu lands for the third time, following the earlier unifications under the Satavahanas and Kakatiyas.
accepted.tq: Use the stated sequence of earlier unifying powers to identify the correct ordinal position.

accepted.s: Which of the following sets consists entirely of Hindus who held high office under the Qutb Shahis?
o: Murari Rao, Jagadeva Rao and Madanna
Hussain Shah Wali, Ibrahim and Madanna
Murari Rao, Abul Hasan and Jagadeva Rao
Madanna, Muhammad Quli and Jagadeva Rao
accepted.x: Murari Rao, Jagadeva Rao and Madanna are identified as Hindus who held high office under the Qutb Shahis.
accepted.tq: Eliminate options containing rulers or other non-matching personalities and retain the complete administrative trio.

accepted.s: During the Qutb Shahi period, Muharram came to be celebrated in Andhra as:
accepted.x: Muharram came to be celebrated as Peerla Panduga during the Qutb Shahi period.
accepted.tq: Separate closely associated regional festival names by linking the specific festival with its religious occasion.
